30: /** A {@link BreakIterator} that splits sentences using an OpenNLP sentence chunking model. */
31: public final class OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator extends BreakIterator {
32: 
33:   private CharacterIterator text;
34:   private int currentSentence;
35:   private int[] sentenceStarts;
36:   private NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceOp;
37: 
38:   public OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceOp) {
39:     this.sentenceOp = sentenceOp;
40:   }
41: 
42:   @Override
43:   public int current() {
44:     return text.getIndex();
45:   }
46: 
47:   @Override
48:   public int first() {
49:     currentSentence = 0;
50:     text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
51:     return current();
52:   }
53: 
54:   @Override
55:   public int last() {
56:     if (sentenceStarts.length > 0) {
57:       currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
58:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
59:     } else { // there are no sentences; both the first and last positions are the begin index
60:       currentSentence = 0;
61:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
62:     }
63:     return current();
64:   }
65: 
66:   @Override
67:   public int next() {
68:     if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex() || 0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
69:       return DONE;
70:     } else if (currentSentence < sentenceStarts.length - 1) {
71:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[++currentSentence]);
72:       return current();
73:     } else {
74:       return last();
75:     }
76:   }
77: 
78:   @Override
79:   public int following(int pos) {
80:     if (pos < text.getBeginIndex() || pos > text.getEndIndex()) {
81:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset out of bounds");
82:     } else if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
83:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
84:       return DONE;
85:     } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[sentenceStarts.length - 1]) {
86:       // this conflicts with the javadocs, but matches actual behavior (Oracle has a bug in
87:       // something)
88:       // https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8015110
89:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
90:       currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
91:       return DONE;
92:     } else { // there are at least two sentences
93:       currentSentence = (sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2; // start search from the middle
94:       moveToSentenceAt(pos, 0, sentenceStarts.length - 2);
95:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[++currentSentence]);
96:       return current();
97:     }
98:   }

100:   /** Binary search over sentences */
101:   private void moveToSentenceAt(int pos, int minSentence, int maxSentence) {
102:     if (minSentence != maxSentence) {
103:       if (pos < sentenceStarts[currentSentence]) {
104:         int newMaxSentence = currentSentence - 1;
105:         currentSentence = minSentence + (currentSentence - minSentence) / 2;
106:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, minSentence, newMaxSentence);
107:       } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1]) {
108:         int newMinSentence = currentSentence + 1;
109:         currentSentence = maxSentence - (maxSentence - currentSentence) / 2;
110:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, newMinSentence, maxSentence);
111:       }
112:     } else {
113:       assert currentSentence == minSentence;
114:       assert pos >= sentenceStarts[currentSentence];
115:       assert (currentSentence == sentenceStarts.length - 1 && pos <= text.getEndIndex())
116:           || pos < sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1];
117:     }
118:     // we have arrived - nothing to do
119:   }

121:   @Override
122:   public int previous() {
123:     if (text.getIndex() == text.getBeginIndex()) {
124:       return DONE;
125:     } else {
126:       if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
127:         text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
128:         return DONE;
129:       }
130:       if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex()) {
131:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
132:       } else {
133:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[--currentSentence]);
134:       }
135:       return current();
136:     }
137:   }
138: 
139:   @Override
140:   public int preceding(int pos) {
141:     if (pos < text.getBeginIndex() || pos > text.getEndIndex()) {
142:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset out of bounds");
143:     }
144:     Span[] detectedSpans = splitSentences();
145:     int detectedBegin =
146:         detectedSpans.length == 0
147:             ? text.getBeginIndex()
148:             : detectedSpans[0].getStart() + text.getBeginIndex();
149:     if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
150:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
151:       currentSentence = 0;
152:       return DONE;
153:     } else if (pos < detectedBegin) {
154:       // this conflicts with the javadocs, but matches actual behavior (Oracle has a bug in

157:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
158:       currentSentence = 0;
159:       return DONE;

162:       moveToSentenceAt(pos, 0, sentenceStarts.length - 1);
163:       if (0 == currentSentence) {
164:         text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
165:         return DONE;
166:       } else {
167:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[--currentSentence]);

169:       }
170:     }
171:   }

174:   public int next(int n) {
175:     currentSentence += n;
176:     if (n < 0) {
177:       if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex()) {
178:         ++currentSentence;
179:       }
180:       if (currentSentence < 0) {
181:         currentSentence = 0;
182:         text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
183:         return DONE;
184:       } else {
185:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
186:       }

188:       if (currentSentence >= sentenceStarts.length) {
189:         currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
190:         text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
191:         return DONE;
192:       } else {
193:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
194:       }
195:     }
196:     return current();
197:   }

199:   @Override
200:   public CharacterIterator getText() {
201:     return text;
202:   }
203: 
204:   @Override
205:   public void setText(CharacterIterator newText) {
206:     text = newText;
207:     text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
208:     currentSentence = 0;
209:     bindDetectionWindow(newText);
210:     Span[] spans = splitSentences();
211:     sentenceStarts = new int[spans.length];
212:     for (int i = 0; i < spans.length; ++i) {
213:       // Adjust start positions to match those of the passed-in CharacterIterator
214:       sentenceStarts[i] = spans[i].getStart() + text.getBeginIndex();
215:     }
216:   }

218:   private void bindDetectionWindow(CharacterIterator newText) {
219:     CharArrayIterator window;
220:     if (newText instanceof CharArrayIterator) {
221:       window = (CharArrayIterator) newText;
222:     } else {
223:       String fullText = characterIteratorToString();
224:       window = CharArrayIterator.newSentenceInstance();
225:       window.setText(fullText.toCharArray(), 0, fullText.length());
226:     }
227:     OffsetAttribute offsets = new OffsetAttributeImpl();
228:     offsets.setOffset(newText.getBeginIndex(), newText.getEndIndex());
229:     window.setWindowOffsets(offsets);
230:     sentenceOp.getTokenizerOp().setTextWindow(window);
231:   }
232: 
233:   private Span[] splitSentences() {
234:     NLPTokenizerOp tokenizerOp = sentenceOp.getTokenizerOp();
235:     CharArrayIterator window = tokenizerOp.getTextWindow();
236:     OffsetAttribute windowOffsets = window.getWindowOffsets();
237:     char[] chars = window.getText();
238:     int windowStart = window.getStart();
239:     int windowLength = window.getLength();
240:     int windowLimit = window.getLimit();
241:     int boundedLength = Math.min(windowLength, windowLimit - windowStart);
242:     int offsetSpan = windowOffsets.endOffset() - windowOffsets.startOffset();
243:     if (offsetSpan >= 0) {
244:       boundedLength = Math.min(boundedLength, offsetSpan);
245:     }
246:     if (boundedLength < 0) {
247:       boundedLength = 0;
248:     }
249:     String line = new String(chars, windowStart, boundedLength);
250:     Span[] termSpans = tokenizerOp.getTerms(line);
251:     int termCoveredLength = line.length();
252:     if (termSpans.length > 0) {
253:       termCoveredLength = termSpans[termSpans.length - 1].getEnd() - termSpans[0].getStart();
254:     }
255:     int splitLength = Math.min(boundedLength, Math.max(termCoveredLength, 0));
256:     String splitLine = new String(chars, windowStart, splitLength);
257:     synchronized (sentenceOp) {
258:       SentenceDetectorME splitter = sentenceOp.getSentenceSplitter();
259:       if (splitter != null) {
260:         return splitter.sentPosDetect(splitLine);
261:       }
262:       return new Span[] {new Span(0, splitLine.length())};
263:     }
264:   }
265: 
266:   private String characterIteratorToString() {
267:     String fullText;
268:     if (text instanceof CharArrayIterator) {
269:       CharArrayIterator charArrayIterator = (CharArrayIterator) text;
270:       fullText =
271:           new String(
272:               charArrayIterator.getText(),
273:               charArrayIterator.getStart(),
274:               charArrayIterator.getLength());
275:     } else {
276:       // TODO: is there a better way to extract full text from arbitrary CharacterIterators?
277:       StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
278:       for (char ch = text.first(); ch != CharacterIterator.DONE; ch = text.next()) {
279:         builder.append(ch);
280:       }
281:       fullText = builder.toString();
282:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
283:     }
284:     return fullText;
285:   }

part.text:
Fixed the issue in lucene/analysis/opennlp/src/java/org/apache/lucene/analysis/opennlp/OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator.java:161 — changed the "start search from the middle" computation in `preceding()` from `sentenceStarts.length / 2` to `(sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2`, matching `following()`, so `currentSentence` stays within bounds and avoids the `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` in `moveToSentenceAt()` when only 2 sentences exist.

Verified by running the full `lucene:analysis:opennlp` test suite (host-side Gradle 8.4 with JDK 21, since the container has no network/Gradle): **33 tests, all passing**, including `TestOpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator` (9 tests, 0 failures).
